brief: Prioritise Fairmount Heights 230/34kV (SUB-SGW-335) for pre-event attention because its advanced age of 34 years and history of high loading leave it with a reduced margin against mechanical failure under thermal stress (MG-023). If this ageing unit cannot be attended before the heat event, apply the loading restriction in MG-021 in preference to accepting the exposure (MG-023). Record every de-rating applied along with its reason, value, and period, and only restore the full rating when the underlying condition has been corrected and verified (MG-021).
